provenance.cross_pattern_replay: One row does not come from unit e3's per-pattern witness sweep. e3 built each witness from the pattern's own parse tree, so no witness it generated for ATR-2026-02351 crossed. Replaying e3's 294 recorded crossing templates against every admitted rule found it on the template generated for ATR-2026-00106: 1.04s at 16KB, 3.67s at 32KB, 15.52s at 64KB, 70.71s at 128KB, a clean factor of four per doubling. A per-pattern witness search generalises poorly across patterns; the table's build step owes a full cross-replay sweep, which has not been run.
provenance.cfg_condition_sweep: Closes the CFG-configuration-channel measurement gap: unit e3 (above) timed each rule's *composed* pattern; agent_defs/cfg.py's _CompiledBinding screens each rule's *individual* conditions one at a time (require_measurement=True as of 2026-09-05), and 1,203 distinct condition strings extracted by scripts/extract_unmeasured.py from the same pinned ATR checkout (faf743fee8a5018467959ec8ea7ccdb1a1aab333) had no row at that granularity. Measured on spark-37f2 (CPython 3.12.3, Linux-6.17.0-1014-nvidia-aarch64) on 2026-09-05 with the unmodified e3_empirical.py harness (same method as this table's other rows: adversarial witness built from each pattern's own parse tree, LENGTHS=[16,31,64,256,1024,4096,16384,65536,262144], 1.10 s discovery cap, 62 s confirmation cap to 1 MiB, one killable subprocess per attempt, budget_s=1.0 matching this table's top-level budget_s): `python3 e3_empirical.py discovery --workers 20` then `python3 e3_empirical.py confirmation --workers 20`, against an extracted.json built from unmeasured-cfg.json with pattern_id set to its own 16-hex fingerprint.
